problem: Let $W$ be a $9\times 10$ matrix that has $8$ pivot columns. What is the dimension of the null space of $W?$
worked_solution:
We know that $\text{dim(Null}(W))$ is the number of non-pivot columns in $W.$ 

Since $W$ has $10$ columns and $8$ of them are pivots, then the number of non-pivot columns in $W$ is 

$$
10-8=2.
$$

Therefore, $\text{dim(Null}(W))=2.$
